label: Впереди
description: A 10-sentence usage card for впереди (ahead, in front).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Static location ahead. 'Впереди' is an adverb marking what lies in front, answering где. It sets the scene before 'я вижу' and points to the space ahead of the speaker.
Strategic focus: Position versus direction. 'Впереди' marks a static position in front, while 'вперёд' marks motion forward. The sentence contrasts the two closely related adverbs directly.
Strategic focus: Figurative location in time. 'Впереди' here means still to come, extending the spatial sense of ahead into the future. It marks where the hardest part lies on the road ahead.
Strategic focus: Static relative position. 'Впереди' modifies the noun phrase to mark the car positioned in front of us. It names a fixed relative location, not motion.
Strategic focus: Leading position. 'Впереди' marks the front spot in a group, modifying 'идёт'. The added 'всех' in the genitive specifies ahead of everyone else.
Strategic focus: What lies ahead. 'Впереди' opens the sentence to mark the space and time before us. It frames the long road as something still to come.
Strategic focus: A goal positioned ahead. 'Впереди' marks the finish line as lying in front, reinforced by 'совсем'. It names a static point toward which the runners move.

missions.phrase: Он всегда сидит впереди в классе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Habitual position. 'Впереди' marks the front of the room as a static location for sitting. The habitual 'всегда' frames it as his usual spot.

missions.phrase: Посмотри, что там впереди на дороге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Scanning the space ahead. 'Впереди' marks the area in front, modifying the implied location of 'что там'. It directs attention to what lies ahead on the road.

missions.phrase: Наша команда сейчас впереди в игре.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Figurative being ahead. 'Впереди' extends the spatial sense of in front to mean leading in a contest. It marks the team's position relative to the opponents.
